_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
v3.2.115

SysID records raw ADC and averaged pressure rate disagreement on the same acquisition frames, bound to live device calibration. Calculations occur after measurements with safe actuator state. Missing/noisy/pulsing input is retained as unavailable. Primary tuning, firmware and saved calibration remain unchanged. Headless SysID shares the GUI direct acquisition feed.
